TEGSA, a Luxembourg company and our 100%-owned subsidiary, is a holding company that owns,
directly or indirectly, all of our operating subsidiaries. TEGSA is the obligor under our senior notes,
commercial paper, and Credit Facility, which are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by its parent, TE
Connectivity Ltd. The following tables present condensed consolidating financial information for TE
Connectivity Ltd., TEGSA, and all other subsidiaries that are not providing a guarantee of debt but
which represent assets of TEGSA, using the equity method of accounting.
